rationale: The GPU surface NSView in metal_surface_mac.mm is declared under its own base name, PulpMetalSurfaceView, instead of under PulpMetalView with a per-binary rename macro that mapped it to that same base. The view layer defines a separate PulpMetalView in window_host_mac.mm, so when the macOS ObjC view cluster is compiled as one unity translation unit per binary the render header's `#define PulpMetalView` would rename the view layer's class too. Declaring the distinct base directly keeps the two names independent with or without the per-binary suffix. The suffixed class name a plug-in registers is byte-identical to before (PULP_RENDER_OBJC_NAME(PulpMetalSurfaceView)); no API, rendering behavior, or authority boundary changes. Pulp-only because Pulp builds and ships this ObjC glue independently and there is no counterpart Vellum commit to backport from.
